notes.title: Intelligence Update - Now Live!
notes.content:
The Architect has become self aware!

[b]Glitchrunners[/b] was original launched with the Glitch Run mode as a second screen game - one screen for up to four runners and the second screen for the Architect. 

With this latest update, up to four players can battle it out for the Powercube against the Architect controlled by the computer. With varying difficulty levels and adaptive AI, this is a whole new way to play [b]Glitchrunners[/b] – even a single player can duke it out against the computer-controlled Architect!
